title: Deciphering the Role of ATP on PHF6 Aggregation.
authors: Pal, Saikat; Roy, Rituparna; Paul, Sandip
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用经典分子动力学模拟研究ATP对Tau蛋白PHF6肽段聚集的抑制作用，属于蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上MD可借鉴，与课题关联度低。
abstract: The aggregation of Tau protein, which are involved in Alzheimer's disease, are associated with the self-assembly of the hexapeptide sequence, paired helical filament 6 (PHF6) from repeat 3 of Tau. In order to treat Alzheimer's disease and other such tauopathies, one of the therapeutic strategies is to inhibit aggregation of Tau and its nucleating segments. Therefore, we have studied the effect of adenosine triphosphate (ATP) on the aggregation of PHF6. ATP has, interestingly, demonstrated its ability to inhibit and dissolve protein aggregates. Using classical molecular dynamics simulations, we observed that the hydrophobic core of PHF6 segment displays extended beta-sheet conformation, which stabilizes PHF6 aggregates. However, the distribution of ATP around the vicinity of the peptides enables PHF6 to remain discrete and attain random coil conformers. The interpeptide interactions are substituted by PHF6-ATP interactions through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interactions (including pi-pi stacking). Furthermore, the adenosine moiety of ATP contributes more than the triphosphate chain toward PHF6-ATP interaction. Ultimately, this work establishes the inhibitory activity of ATP against Tau aggregation; hence, the therapeutic effect of ATP should be explored further in regard to the effective treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
abstract_zh: 与阿尔茨海默病相关的Tau蛋白聚集，与Tau蛋白第3重复区中的六肽序列——配对螺旋丝6（PHF6）的自组装有关。为了治疗阿尔茨海默病及其他此类tau蛋白病，治疗策略之一便是抑制Tau及其成核片段的聚集。因此，我们研究了三磷酸腺苷（ATP）对PHF6聚集的影响。有趣的是，ATP已显示出抑制和溶解蛋白质聚集体的能力。通过经典分子动力学模拟，我们观察到PHF6片段的疏水核心呈现延伸的β-折叠构象，这稳定了PHF6聚集体。然而，ATP在肽段周围的分布使PHF6保持离散状态，并形成随机卷曲构象。肽间相互作用被PHF6-ATP相互作用所取代，这种作用通过氢键和疏水相互作用（包括π-π堆积）实现。此外，ATP的腺苷部分对PHF6-ATP相互作用的贡献大于三磷酸链。最终，本研究确立了ATP对Tau聚集的抑制活性；因此，应进一步探索ATP在有效治疗阿尔茨海默病方面的治疗潜力。
